meta.requirement: Explore Falcon Coast (10%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: A Fisherman's Challenge
start.text:
''Bram waves you over with his fishing rod.''

Bram: Still got that rod I gave you? How about a fishing contest?

What_are_the_rules_.text: Bram: You've got twelve hours to bring me the biggest fish you can catch. Just one, mind, so make sure it's the one you want to hand in.

You_re_on.text: Bram: Go on then, I'll be here.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Submit your biggest fish to Bram within twelve hours

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Submit a fish to Bram

Submit_a_fish_to_Bram.text:
Bram: Let's have a look, then. You don't get to swap it after.

Only carried, unfavorited fish appear below.
